blocks.text: TURIN–Carlos Alcaraz reached the last four of the ATP Finals on Wednesday thanks to Frances Tiafoe after the Spaniard had earlier brushed aside world number five Daniil Medvedev 6-2, 6-4. American Tiafoe beat Italian Flavio Cobolli 7-6 (8/6), 6-0 with his first set guaranteeing Alcaraz’s spot in the next round.
